spiritual_reading:
Active falsity, which had prevailed through obscurity, was brought into subjection by a sufficient series of Divine operations.

The first operation is the inmost Divine Itself, existing in peace and unsearchable interiority, remaining within its own wisdom in the purity of its own being.

From that inmost Divine, a fullness of derivative Divine operations came forth into manifestation. They were disposed into complete conjunction as to the working powers in the outer degree, and they were established as an entire organized body of truths and goods in their fullness.

The second operation proceeded and came into manifestation, revealed from the first. It is the Divine wisdom-principle in living activity, together with the good that first engages evil in order to restore order, and with a sufficient complement of subordinate operative powers acting from that good. These together are the second operation.

The third operation is Divine love for all truths and goods, ordering and forming them for use, namely the living proceeding Divine that builds and disposes, together with a sufficient complement of subordinate powers proceeding from that living Divine for executing its uses. These together are the third operation.

The fourth operation is Divine mediation in its third degree, together with the upholding Divine that sustains what has been arranged, and with all the luminous powers of understanding and use that were brought forth through it. These together are the fourth operation.

The fifth operation that proceeded from the inmost Divine is Divine truth in its splendour as it reaches the outermost, together with all the powers it calls forth for operation, namely its derivations and proceedents, which poured forth and came into manifestation from it.

This was so arranged that the Divine operations might be extended in sufficient series: one sufficiency as the subordinate powers of the first engaging good in the whole work, and another sufficiency as the subordinate powers of the living proceeding Divine extended into a full set of positions and functions, sustaining the ordered whole.

Thus the whole was made complete in the organized fullness of truths and goods. To this fullness two were added—reception and compliance—so that there might be responsive conjunction. These two were appointed as a succeeding principle in the place of the Divine splendour in the lower degree, to govern the outermost plane in which all things are held together.

The descent of the first engaging good occurred as when a noble truth from a higher state is present among those of its own spiritual household, yet is assailed by opposing falsities and suffers from their evil. They strip from it what is serviceable and abundant, they confine it under their dominion, and they attempt to deprive it of its attendant powers; yet it endures by humility, gathers courage, and restrains the opposing force by withholding consent, remaining in interior peace.

As a noble truth is surrounded by adversaries, so the descent of that first engaging good took place among dominant falsities, the adversaries of illumination.

But the descent of the living proceeding Divine and the mandate it received, by which it came upon the dominant falsities, differs from the first descent, though it is related to it.

The descent of the living proceeding Divine is this: it was sent from the Divine operations to lift up the first engaging good. It is like authoritative judgment sent from the highest order to overturn the violence done to noble truth by falsities that had violated order. That judgment is executed with unwavering firmness against what is cruel and perverted; it provides means of restoration through righteousness and strength; it evaluates and condemns all that is condemned by rebellious intention, repaying each according to its quality. Those who require sharp correction it restrains by severe chastisement; those who must be deprived of their capacities to do harm it renders powerless in the very faculties by which they injured; those who must be held fast it binds in lasting constraint, fixing them in their inverted states; those whose life is wholly against good it extinguishes as to their power of acting, so that the destructive tendency is brought to an end. Those who must be removed from their former influence it casts out from the spheres in which they dwelt, according to just order, as they had acted against noble truth.

The associate powers within this secret working, the assistants belonging to that judgment in great strength, instantly and swiftly execute the will of the governing Divine.

As that authoritative judgment was sent from the highest order to overturn violence done to noble truth, so it was with the living proceeding Divine. It was sent from the Divine of illumination to overturn vengeance and oppression against the first engaging good, which the ruling falsity of the obscured domain had committed. That ruling falsity, with its rebellious derivatives, violated order against it; therefore, when the living proceeding Divine came, it raised up the first engaging good.

It also judged all dominant falsities and evils that had violated order against the subordinate operative powers of the first engaging good. It fixed them in constraint in the higher and lower degrees, assigning each to the state fitting to it, weighing each by its cruelty and oppression. Some it shut within interior restraints; others it turned into states of complete inversion; some it fixed in a most grievous exposure and immobilization; others it forced into perpetual passivity. Some it fixed beneath the influence of their like, limited by strong restriction; others it allowed to hold a delegated dominance over those beneath them, so that their delight might be spent upon those who are in similar disorder under them.

Know, then, that when the Divine of life set order by these judgments, it was made manifest even to the powers of obscurity. It judged them as genuine judgment itself. This was the first judgment the living proceeding Divine executed upon the dominant falsities with respect to the first engaging good. It gave victory to that good according to the measure and nature of its victory; but it condemned the ruling falsity of the obscured domain according to the manner in which it had perverted.

Thus the fixed constraint remained in the outermost degree until the end, when the entire formed system will be dissolved: what is evil will perish by the final ardour of self-love brought to its consummation, and separation will be made. What is of illumination will return to its proper state; what is of obscurity will remain in everlasting restraint and confinement.

The descent also of the third mediating Divine, when it came to examine those held bound in the intermediate region, is like governing providence that inspects those performing uses and maintaining order.

It distinguishes those who are good in their functions—those who form, arrange, and execute within each assigned position—and sees that they have worked well and have fallen into the uses of the whole according to their proper form. It rejoices with great joy and confirms those who have carried out the ordered work and fulfilled what was commanded.

As governing providence inspects its ordered works and the protections of order, so is the descent of the third mediating Divine. For when it came, it saw the ordered structures established and prepared, and it saw the series of dominant falsities disposed and fixed in their places above and below, outwardly and inwardly, according to the great pattern the preceding Divine operations had made. Those operations had preceded it in the conflict, having fixed and brought the formed system into being before it arrived. It saw the heavenly and spiritual ministrations established, administering the protections of order and guarding the whole government of states, which the first operations had effected: the first engaging good, the living proceeding Divine, and the Divine wisdom-principle.

Therefore, seeing that they had formed and ordered all things with great wisdom, it further brought hidden things to disclosure and, by its presence, made itself manifest to them. It spoke to the living proceeding Divine: the judgment you executed is good; you apportioned to each according to order, so that even those who were unworthy were moved and lifted into states they did not merit—this part of the process is now to be rectified.

The descent also of Divine truth in splendour, when it came to all states below, is like a decisive purification sent to uproot what is obstinately evil and to consume a difficult network of perverted perceptions by ardent love. It first removes the hardened falsities by the cutting power of truth, and it extirpates the root-intentions, consuming their persuasions by purifying ardour, so that they do not return to revive, nor bring forth works that are evil and destructive.

Afterward it implants what is good: living good and living truth that bring forth beneficial works.

So it was with the descent of Divine truth in splendour. For it went forth in power and wisdom, acting as sovereign and saviour in the lower degree; by glorious wisdom it destroyed the resisting evils and falsities. It bound and crushed them, as consuming ardour destroys what is perverted in perception and its resulting works. Thus it carried out its will in the intermediate region among many powers, until it reached the outermost human state in its first formed condition, where the most ancient human principle stood as the first recipient. It completed its work in the receptive affection, and it gave hope to the understanding, announcing glad tidings of restoration and illumination; then it elevated that state toward higher reception of light.

Then responsive conjunction—reception and compliance—the great counsel proceeding into the ultimate constituents set in mutual bond, entered into them and remained held in interior peace. It sustains the ordered process until the end, when it can arise and stand firm in the final ardour that makes separation. It will gather to itself what is its own life, form it into the final unified human form of order, and purge away whatever is impure and alien to it. But the life and illumination dispersed through all states it gathers into itself and builds into its own organized fullness.

When this final unified form is perfected in all its powers and functions, it becomes free and ascends out of the great contention through the living proceeding Divine as its originating support, which comes and brings each power into its place, lifting it out from the midst of the collecting and separating process in which all things are brought to their end.

This counsel of responsive conjunction is like a gentle good held in a calm state: when it is introduced into living truth warmed by love, it yields and permeates that truth. It is received quietly into the inmost of that truth, and then whatever is of vitality and delight in the truth is drawn into the conjunction; afterward what is merely cold, inert, and unsuitable is clarified and cast away, but what is pure, rich, and beautiful is gathered into the conjunction.

So also is the descent of that living counsel—responsive conjunction—which came into the ultimate constituents. For at the end it can arise and stand firm, gathering into itself all lives and the illumination that has remained hidden throughout every state. It can build them into its own organized form, gathering them into itself to remain in its image to eternity from that time.

fills.fill: When the battle was raised against
fills.notes: Opening formula must introduce the primal contest and set the subject for “the darkness … defeated by five greatnesses.” The substrate voice is impersonal and cosmogonic, not hagiographic; hence a neutral battle-setting clause.
The fifth greatness (Splendour) reaches the outermost; its emanations are typically said to be ‘revealed in the elements’ in this register, matching the spiritual sense ‘as it reaches the outermost’.
Bridges from the list of emanations to the explanation of their functional spreading-out; a simple narrative hinge fits the substrate style.
Editor’s fill fits: the fivefold is explicitly the five sons of the First Man in this teaching layer.

fills.fill: who are spread out to five places, supporting
fills.notes: Parallelism demands the same distribution language used a few words later for the Living Spirit’s five sons; both fives are ‘spread out’ and ‘support’ the ordered construction.
The sentence contrasts ‘the entire building’ with what is ‘supporting …’; ‘the whole’ is the natural completion and matches the spiritual sense ‘sustaining the ordered whole’.
Needs a summative transition from the two fives to the twelvefold total.
The bracket begins the clause that asserts the total and then appends the additional two; ‘And they are’ cleanly introduces the arithmetic statement.
The phrase ‘total in twelve parts that …’ calls for a verb of establishment or appointment consistent with earlier ‘appointed to ten parts’ and ‘established’.

The successors (summons and obedience) are appointed ‘to his place’ and therefore exercise governance over the ‘great earth’ and what is in it; this matches the spiritual sense ‘to govern the outermost plane’.
Removes the later editorial ellipsis and restores the simple substrate heading for the simile that follows.

fills.fill: from the heights to the depths
fills.notes: The simile requires a descent from a higher degree into a lower contested one, corresponding to ‘a noble truth from a higher state is present… yet is assailed’.
The spiritual translation explicitly has ‘those of its own spiritual household’; the natural image must name that household.
Smooths the clause ‘existing in a kingdom … esteem’ into a coherent description of standing and regard.
Pairs naturally with ‘esteem’ in this register and suits the noble-son simile.
Introduces the adversative turn: despite honour, enemies assault him.
Gives the required action of enemies preceding ‘and suffering by their wickedness’.
Editor’s fill is required by the immediately following ‘captivity’.
The enemies try to take away his ‘companies’; in the substrate this is typically his attendants or servants, corresponding to subordinate operative powers.
Matches the spiritual sense ‘yet it endures by humility’ and fits the syntax ‘Yet, he … by his humility’.
Connects the simile to the cosmogonic referent: it happened ‘among’ the rulers.
The sentence explicitly contrasts the two advents; ‘it differs from’ is already present, but the lacuna must supply the direct negation that sets up the comparison.
The judge is characterized by unwavering firmness in executing judgement, matching the spiritual sense.
Introduces the objects of judgement, leading into ‘hard and cruel’.
In the oldest register, the judge ‘gives the means’ for restoring the assaulted noble one; ‘means of salvation’ is functional, not devotional, and matches ‘means of restoration’.
List of punishments: blows, cutting off limbs, or their ears—an idiom of disabling powers of reception and obedience in the opposite sense.

fills.fill: Again, those who are worthy of imprisonment
fills.notes: The next action is binding and fettering; thus the missing clause must introduce imprisonment as the fitting sentence.
‘hangs by …’ is naturally ‘by their feet’, corresponding to inversion of state (head down elsewhere).
Completes ‘flay their skin …’ with the common paired object ‘flesh’, emphasizing total removal of power in the opposite sense.
The death described is qualitative, not merely physical: a ‘strange and bitter’ death corresponds to extinguishing the power of acting from evil.
Editor’s fill is mechanically required by the syntax.
Gives the infinitive governed by ‘it is fitting … to banish’; aligns with the spiritual sense ‘casts out from the spheres’.
Introduces the enumeration of differing sentences (‘Some … are crucified’).
The idiom ‘Happen you know this …’ requires an object like ‘this thing’ before ‘that when…’.
The Father of Life ‘established the judgements’; adding ‘and established’ reinforces the setting of order by judgement, matching the spiritual sense ‘set order’.
Completes ‘as a true giver of judgement …’ with the quality of that judgement; righteousness is the correspondential measure.
Editor’s fill fits the required relational clause.
Introduces the consequence from the first judgement to the enduring chain.
The chain ‘became … the earth’ needs the idea of fixed constraint in the outermost; ‘fixed’ matches the spiritual sense.
A king inspecting craftsmen commonly also inspects soldiers guarding works; corresponds to providence inspecting functions maintaining order.
Echoed explicitly in ¶21 (‘works and fortifications’), so it should already appear in the initial simile list.
Completes the triad with a role aligned to maintaining order; also prepares for ¶21’s ‘guarding’.
The king rejoices ‘with great joy …’ and then thanks them; ‘in their presence’ is a natural bridge.
Editor’s fill matches the sense ‘fulfilled what was commanded’.
Editor’s fill fits exactly.
After ‘established and prepared’ a third participle like ‘arranged’ completes the triad of orderly disposition.
Needed to join ‘guarding the entire ruling-power … which…’; simplest syntactic connector.
The ‘ruling-power’ being guarded is over the formed system; ‘of the universe’ matches the teaching layer’s cosmological scope.
The spiritual sense says ‘brought hidden things to disclosure’; this is the natural counterpart.
Completes ‘unveiled to them’; required dative object.
‘The judgement that you have … good’ needs ‘done is good’ as the predicate in this register.
Matches the spiritual sense ‘apportioned to each according to order’ and fits the immediate ‘you gave to them correspondingly’.
Jesus the Splendour comes ‘to all …’; in this layer that is ‘all the powers below’, matching the spiritual sense ‘all states below’.
The tool is for pulling out a ‘root’, matching the later ‘pulled out …’ and the spiritual sense ‘root-intentions’.
Completes ‘has pulled out … and their body’; the natural counterpart of extirpating root-intentions.
Closes the clause ‘nor bear fruit bad to eat …’ with a firm cessation, matching the spiritual sense ‘do not return’.
The action begins in the intermediate region; this matches the repeated ‘in the zone’ later in the paragraph.
The phrase ‘in his …-ness … a king and a saviour’ calls for a quality of merciful governance; ‘compassion’ fits the substrate without Christianizing.
Introduces the appositional role ‘as a king and a saviour’.
Completes the triadic royal function in this layer: king, saviour, healer—functional restoration rather than pastoral piety.
Editor’s fill fits the subsequent ‘his will in Eve’.
Corresponds to completing the work in the receptive affection (Eve) by purification, matching the spiritual sense.
Pairs with ‘He also gave hope to Adam’—hope is toward life restored.
The ‘good news’ is of restoration; ‘saved’ here is structural deliverance from mixture, consistent with the substrate.
Completes ‘He went up to the heights … of light’ with a genitive phrase; ‘glory of light’ is standard for ascent to the luminous degree.
‘It bears up … until the end time’ requires the pronoun for the counsel (summons and obedience).
The Living Spirit ‘comes and brings a … limb’; the spiritual sense says ‘brings each power into its place’. Thus ‘each’ is demanded.
After ‘to the midst … yet also,’ the clause needs ‘of it’ referring to the milk’s power and taste present within the mixture.
‘of the power and the taste of this milk … is drawn’ needs ‘that’ to introduce the relative clause.
Joins the two results: the drawn-in goodness and the cooling/setting of what remains.
Signals the second phase: after drawing in, clarification and casting away occurs.
The discarded part of milk in this simile is ‘whey’, corresponding to what is cold and unsuitable being clarified and cast away.
‘gather them in to it … in its image’ is followed by an eternal stabilization; ‘in calm’ matches the substrate’s emphasis on rest and fixed order.
Completes the closing: gathered ‘in its image … from this time’ to remain ‘in its form’, i.e., the final organized human form (Last Statue).

assessment: Most gaps can be restored at the level of function and correspondential structure because the chapter is a tightly patterned series: five operations, two added principles, and four advent-similes each with characteristic actions (descent, judgement, inspection, purification, final gathering). Where the lacuna touches stock cosmological phrasing (distribution to five places, judgement-sentences, disclosure of hidden things, uprooting roots, ascent to glory), restorations are moderately to strongly constrained. A few items remain tentative where the natural simile could take multiple equivalent forms (e.g., the king’s inspection list; the exact epithet in ¶25; the qualitative description of ‘death’ in ¶13), but even there the spiritual logic fixes the required function (inversion, disabling, extinction, separation) and keeps the wording within the oldest impersonal cosmological register.
